subject: cd
question: Construct the sets of LR(0) items and LR(1) items for E→BB, B→bB, B→c.
title: 7 States or 10?
hook: 7 states or 10? Same grammar, different automaton.
answer: Augment the grammar: E'→E, E→BB, B→bB, B→c

LR(0) sets (7): I0={E'→•E, E→•BB, B→•bB, B→•c}; I1=goto(I0,E)={E'→E•}; I2=goto(I0,B)={E→B•B, B→•bB, B→•c}; I3=goto(I0,b)={B→b•B, B→•bB, B→•c}; I4=goto(I0,c)={B→c•}; I5=goto(I2,B)={E→BB•}; I6=goto(I3,B)={B→bB•}; goto(I2,b)=goto(I3,b)=I3 and goto(I2,c)=goto(I3,c)=I4
LR(1) item = LR(0) item + lookahead. I0={E'→•E,$; E→•BB,$; B→•bB,b/c; B→•c,b/c}, I2={E→B•B,$; B→•bB,$; B→•c,$}, I3={B→b•B,b/c; B→•bB,b/c; B→•c,b/c}
Same core with different lookaheads gives different states: B→b•B, B→c• and B→bB• each split into a b/c copy and a $ copy
Total: 7 LR(0) states, 10 LR(1) states. Memory: LR(1) = LR(0) + lookahead splits
